_note: Logos are cropped from the real source graphics by assets/extract_sponsor_logos.py. Only predator + intel are mandatory: they appear at identical size in every Predator League graphic (bracket_1, match_announcement_2 and their _wrong variants), so those validate clean. intel_core and valorant are registered but optional — promote them into mandatory_by_type to exercise more findings (valorant is 0.83% of canvas, so it will trip the 1% too-small rule).
_roster_update_note: Left empty on purpose: the three roster graphics are three unrelated tournaments (Zeus/PUBG, Team Raise/BGMI), sharing no sponsor. Anything mandatory here would be a guaranteed false 'missing'. Extract PUBG or BGMI and add it if you want to cover this type.

visibility_rules.comment: A mandatory logo must occupy at least ~1% of the canvas area and sit on a background it contrasts against; otherwise it is flagged as low-visibility.
